title: Decision: raw ECDH shared secret Z never leaves kernel in agree()
description: DO_AGREE computes ECDH and HKDF entirely inside the provider; only OKM is returned to userspace. Raw Z is never written to the fd's outbuf or any userspace-accessible buffer. This is required by FIPS 140-3: the validated module must not expose raw DH output. A reviewer suggesting 'return Z and let userspace run their KDF' would: (1) violate FIPS 140-3; (2) expose a secret of the same strength as the private key; (3) create an unapproved usage pattern where the KDF choice is uncontrolled. The HKDF parameters (salt, info, okm_len) in the ioctl give callers full control over derivation without exposing Z.
close_reason: Reviewed, documented, and hardened in CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, and AGENTS.md
